coverage.review: Sequential full source read, including intros, intermissions, sideboarding and results. No additional featured matches within this interval.

games.summary: Rain8715 finds Burst Asunder to finish through metari211’s potion recovery.

beats.text: Aqua Vitae and Revitalizer X Ultra set up recovery while Rain8715 builds a Fractal board.
Glimmering Refusal stops Dungeon Guide, forcing metari211 to level up with an empty hand.
Aqua Vitae and a brewed Soothing Potion refill metari211’s hand before Regal Inquisition strips key cards.
Frostsworn Paladin draws the Burst Asunder that closes game one.

games.summary: Rain8715 fires a lethal missile chain before Arisanna reaches level 3.

beats.text: Ingredient Pouch brings out Polaris, and Aqua Vitae later restores metari211’s hand.
Refracting Missile starts the pressure as Rain8715 builds to eight Fractals.
Rain8715 chains Refracting Missile and Shimmering Refraction into the level-up window; the spirit release and healing herbs cannot save metari211.

games.summary: Zefier punishes two Lorraine level-ups with a burst of Scalding Aethercharge damage.

beats.text: Reclaim saves Aesan Protector from Cinder Geyser, then another Protector keeps the pressure on Zefier.
Combustible Potion builds Essence Crucible, and Varuck shuts off fire-damage prevention.
Two Scalding Aethercharges and Everflame Staff finish ExcitedCat after Lorraine levels twice in one turn.

games.summary: ExcitedCat suppresses Essence Crucible and closes with Numinous Monk.

beats.text: Fanned Synchron punishes ExcitedCat’s ally development with repeated damage.
Clarent’s prevention stops Searing Rebuke from converting Zefier’s self-damage into a burst.
Aella suppresses Essence Crucible while Veiling Breeze cuts into the burn sequence.
Annul Spell denies Restorative Flame, and Numinous Monk turns Purifying Thurible into the final damage.

games.summary: ExcitedCat survives the burn combo and negates Intensified Pyre to win the match.

beats.text: An early Fanned Synchron slows ExcitedCat’s Windmill Engineer hand while Zefier struggles to develop.
Zefier brews to three Essence Crucible counters and uses his own potions to trigger two Searing Rebukes.
ExcitedCat rebuilds after Polaris, then Annul Spell stops the lethal Intensified Pyre and secures the match.

games.summary: DeRealDeal’s repeated Poitier attacks exhaust Lifdrasyl’s defenses.

beats.text: Two Remnants of Will raise DeRealDeal to eight haunt counters, and Phantasmagoria mills Poitier.
Slip Away targets a defender and draws Engulf, opening another fight over Lifdrasyl’s blocking board.
Undying Dreams and successive Poitiers force Song of Frost and a Genbu flip; another Slip Away prompts Lifdrasyl’s concession.

games.summary: Game two remains unfinished at time; DeRealDeal wins the match 1–0.

beats.text: Spirelle negates Memory Invocation, then reloads its three-cost answer to hold up Lifdrasyl’s development.
Remnant of Will restores DeRealDeal’s life while Lifdrasyl mills the remaining Unbroken Mustang.
Resolute Stand skips the next draw, and Reflected Blight recovers it as Lifdrasyl sets up repeated Polar Depths.
Lifdrasyl turns Chime of Endless Dreams into a Fractal, but time ends the unfinished game with DeRealDeal ahead 1–0.

games.summary: Yadon protects the level-up and outlasts Feu Awakening before closing with Luxem attacks.

beats.text: Incapacitate stops Topsy Decree, preserving Yadon’s floating memory for level 2 and returning Incapacitate to hand.
Gleaming Cut and Luxem Sight build Yadon’s hand; Striking Illuminance turns the reveals into pressure and recovery.
Topsy Decree blocks Ciel’s damage triggers, leaving Yadon free to finish with Lightweaver’s Assault.

games.summary: Yadon’s reveal engine keeps him ahead through Legilus’s Accursed Strength refill.

beats.text: Dungeon Guide reaches Zander level 3 without banishing the key Luxem cards.
Backup Charger finds Gleaming Cut, and Luxem reveals rebuild Yadon’s hand while recovering damage.
Legilus pairs Feu Awakening with Accursed Strength to refill, but Topsy Decree protects Yadon from Ciel’s triggers.
Yadon forces Legilus’s hand down and closes with Lightweaver’s Assault.

games.summary: EnochLok123’s fast Genbu setup wins before hachico can reach level 3.

beats.text: Fractal of Rain and Tidestone Bovine accelerate the quest counters for Genbu.
Engulf stops hachico’s Dungeon Guide and keeps Ciel at level 2.
Genbu flips and Resonating Fugue converts its life into a game-ending attack.

games.summary: hachico clears the early board and finishes with Feu Awakening and Devouring Malice.

beats.text: Devastating Blow removes Tidestone Bovine, and Topsy Decree strips EnochLok123’s graveyard resources.
Manxome Armoire retrieves Devastating Blow and helps clear Frostsworn Paladin before Ciel attacks.
Feu Awakening and Devouring Malice combine during EnochLok123’s materialization to tie the match.

games.summary: Five Guides establish hachico’s lead, and Beguiling Coup bypasses Genbu to close.

beats.text: Three Liminal Guides refill hachico’s hand, and two Dungeon Guides accelerate Ciel to level 3.
A judge check pauses play over Ciel’s missing mastery marker; the game resumes with the mastery on the board.
The Guides clear Tidestone Bovine, then Devastating Blow puts EnochLok123 within lethal range.
Regal Inquisition removes Frostbind and Cerulean Decree; Beguiling Coup bypasses Genbu, and Enfeebling Orb cannot stop the finishing attack.
